method: A commitment is included only when its original wording is specific enough to test and a dated source can be preserved. Outcomes are checked against public records. Council-wide results are labelled as council-wide and are not credited to one councillor without evidence of a distinct individual action. No aggregate promise-kept score is published until at least five reviewed commitments exist for that person and comparable review has been completed for other incumbent candidates.

items.commitment: Provide real engagement and be a councillor residents can connect with.
items.check: Ward 2 continued to publish recurring councillor updates and hold resident meetings. City material for 2025 and 2026 lists Ward 2 updates, budget workshops, walking tours and other engagement events.

items.commitment: Support connected walking and cycling routes through completion of Burlington's Integrated Mobility Plan.
items.check: Burlington City Council unanimously approved the first Integrated Mobility Plan on Nov. 14, 2023. The approval is evidence that the policy moved forward, but it is a council-wide result rather than an individual accomplishment.

items.commitment: Support increasing and prioritizing public EV chargers on City property.
items.check: The City reports public charging stations at municipal lots and community facilities, and its climate reporting records additional City-property charging installations. This shows the policy direction advanced, but does not by itself establish individual credit.

items.commitment: Deliver on Burlington's Housing Strategy roadmap to increase housing options.
items.check: The City funded a Housing Strategy implementation role in the 2024 budget and later adopted Official Plan changes tied to Housing Strategy implementation. The strategy remains an ongoing city program rather than a completed one-person promise.
